name: Used role link explains it was already used
description: Reopening a one-use role link must say the link was used or expired, not blame the connection.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /demo in a fresh browser context and wait until the page heading 'Today' is shown
Open 'Sample controls' and click 'Open recipient role'
Copy the URL of the 'Continue as Leo in a separate tab' link, then open it and wait for Leo's workspace
Navigate to the same copied link URL again
Verify the page explains the role link was already used or has expired and offers a way forward
Verify the page does NOT say 'Check your connection and try again'
